006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.ITokenItem;
012import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
013import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
014import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016
017/**
018 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
019 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#token">token</a>
020 * data type.
021 */
022public class TokenAdapter
023    extends AbstractStringAdapter<ITokenItem> {
024  @NonNull
025  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
026      List.of(
027          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "token")));
028
029  TokenAdapter() {
030    super(ITokenItem.class, ITokenItem::cast);
031    // avoid general construction
032  }
033
034  @Override
035  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
036    return NAMES;
037  }
038
039  @Override
040  public ITokenItem newItem(Object value) {
041    String item = asString(value);
042    return ITokenItem.valueOf(item);
043  }
044}
